item.title: British minister pushes back on Israeli warning that Iran’s missiles can reach Europe
item.description: British minister disputes Israeli claims on Iran’s missile reach into Europe, despite recent strikes and warnings highlighting Tehran’s long-range capabilities.

item.title: Hezbollah attack kills woman, wounds 2 others in northern Israel | Pakistan ready to host US-Iran ceasefire talks | 4 wounded by shrapnel impact in southern Israel
item.description: Hezbollah attack kills woman, wounds 2 others in northern Israel | Pakistan ready to host US-Iran ceasefire talks | 4 wounded by shrapnel impact in southern Israel

item.title: Is the Iran war ending? Backchannel diplomacy led to Trump’s surprise announcement but Tehran stays hesitant
item.description: Is the Iran war ending? Backchannel US-Iran talks spark hopes, but Tehran hesitates as Gulf states grow impatient and US troops deploy.

item.title: Miracle near Haifa? Resident narrowly avoids death as Iranian cluster munition explodes inside his apartment
item.description: Resident near Haifa narrowly escapes death as Iranian cluster munition hits apartment; missile strikes injure civilians and damage buildings in Tel Aviv.

item.title: FM Smotrich urges moving border to Litani River as DM Katz vows Lebanese residents won’t return south until Israelis are safe
item.description: Finance Minister Smotrich urges Israel-Lebanon border at Litani River; DM Katz says southern Lebanese won’t return until northern Israelis are safe.

item.title: Understanding the interception failures in Arad & Dimona: How does the IDF decide which interceptor system to use?
item.description: IDF interception failures in Arad and Dimona raise questions as military explains how it selects Arrow or David’s Sling systems amid evolving missile threats.

item.title: Netanyahu pardon request: Heritage Minister Eliyahu submits opinion paper to President Herzog
item.description: Israeli minister submits opinion on Netanyahu pardon as Herzog resists pressure, including from Trump, vowing to decide solely by law and national interest.

item.title: Untold story of Shulamit Cohen, Mossad spy who operated in the heart of Lebanon
item.description: The untold story of Shulamit Cohen Kishik, the Mossad spy who risked everything inside Lebanon—surviving capture, torture, and a death sentence to return home.

item.title: Miracle amid destruction: Iranian missiles hit Israeli homes, but no lives lost in Arad and Dimona
item.description: Iranian missiles devastate homes in Arad and Dimona, leaving hundreds injured—yet no fatalities, as residents recount survival and resilience.

item.title: Is this Iran's 'Delcy'? Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf, the corrupt general turned politician apparently leading talks with the US
item.description: Reports identify Iran’s parliament speaker Ghalibaf as Trump’s mystery contact, but experts warn the IRGC-linked insider is a hardliner, not a reformer.
